recognize_zh: 高倍 H&E 下細胞組成很雜：小淋巴球、核偏心的漿細胞樣細胞，加上左側一顆核大、染色質開、中央有明顯核仁的免疫母細胞（immunoblast）；這種從小淋巴球到大細胞全都有的多形性浸潤，是多形性 PTLD 的特徵。
features: Polymorphous infiltrate of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid cells and large transformed cells
Large immunoblast (left) with vesicular nucleus and prominent central nucleolus
Plasmacytoid cells with eccentric nuclei and coarse chromatin
Intermediate cells with irregular, hyperchromatic nuclei
Loose, edematous background with delicate stroma; occasional red cell
describe_en: High-power H&E section shows a polymorphous lymphoplasmacytic infiltrate composed of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid cells with eccentric nuclei, intermediate cells with irregular hyperchromatic nuclei, and scattered large immunoblasts with vesicular chromatin and prominent central nucleoli. The background is loose and edematous. There is no monotonous sheet of large cells in this field. Findings are consistent with polymorphic post-transplant lymphoproliferative disorder.

ddx.vs: Monomorphic PTLD consists of sheets of large transformed cells, whereas this field shows the full spectrum from small lymphocytes to plasma cells and immunoblasts.
Infectious mononucleosis-like PTLD shows paracortical expansion with immunoblasts but preserved architecture, which cannot be judged at this high power.
cHL has diagnostic Reed-Sternberg cells that are CD30+, CD15+, CD45- and PAX5 weak in an inflammatory background, whereas PTLD immunoblasts usually retain CD20 and CD45.
THRLBCL has scattered large B cells in a background dominated by T cells and histiocytes, with few plasma cells.
